_help: Windows-only, no Linux/macOS counterpart: .ico is a Windows-specific format (favicons and the like are typically just PNG everywhere else), so there's little real need to preview one outside Windows. Previews Windows .ico files with a private build of netpbm's ico2png, which extracts the largest size in the icon as PNG — not a publicly-downloadable tool, so replace <ICO2PNG_PATH> with wherever your own equivalent lives (or write your own: any command that turns an .ico into a PNG works). Waydir ignores every key starting with "_".
